question.text: Per the official DEA Induction Material (verified 2026-05-15), the Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM) handles which of the following?

answer.text: Systematic disinvestment and privatization of Public Sector Undertakings and policy relating to utilization of disinvestment proceeds
Privatization of the Reserve Bank of India

explanation.text: The Logic: The Department of Disinvestment was renamed Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM). DIPAM is responsible for systematic disinvestment/privatization of Public Sector Undertakings and the policy on utilization of disinvestment proceeds. The NISM XV workbook still uses the older "Department of Disinvestment" label. The Trap: Sale of government land, RBI bonds, and RBI privatization are not DIPAM mandates. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XV (Ch 14) and the official DEA pages; current SEBI and Government of India materials reference DIPAM.
